keyword: do not fill blank concrete pump specifications

title.en: Leave Blank Xingtai Catalogue Cells Blank on the Order
title.zh: 邢台目录的空白格在订单上保持空白

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai leaves some cells empty: Diesel 60 has no aggregate, Electric 15 has no pressure or hopper, LZ-80’s delivery height says consult the factory. The purchase order repeats the blank.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把一些格子留空：柴油60没有骨料，电动15没有压力或料斗，LZ-80 的输送高度写咨询工厂。采购订单照样留空。

h1.en: A Blank Cell Is Part of the Published Sheet
h1.zh: 空白格是已公布参数表的一部分

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes blanks on purpose. Diesel 60 does not print aggregate size. Electric 15 does not print outlet pressure or hopper volume. Electric 10 Series does not print a vertical distance. Most electric pages do not print voltage; B500S-83D does print 380 V. LZ-80 prints delivery height as “consult factory standard” rather than a metre number. Copying a filled cell from the next model invents a specification. The order should say “not printed” and send the site measurement separately.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）有意公布空白。柴油60不印骨料粒径。电动15不印出口压力或料斗容积。电动10系列不印垂直距离。多数电动页不印电压；B500S-83D 印了 380 V。LZ-80 的输送高度写成“咨询工厂标准”，而不是一个米数。从下一台型号抄一个已填格子，就是在编规格。订单应写“未印”，并把现场测量另行发送。

heading.en: What you may still tell the factory
heading.zh: 你仍然可以告诉工厂什么

body.en: Maximum aggregate, required output, horizontal and vertical metres, and voltage and frequency are inquiry facts about the site. They are not permission to rewrite the catalogue cell. Both can sit in one message to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
body.zh: 最大骨料、目标输送量、水平与垂直米数、电压和频率是关于现场的询盘事实。它们不是改写目录格的许可。两者可以放在发给 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/) 的同一封信里。

heading.en: Shared codes do not fill blanks
heading.zh: 共享代码不会填补空白

body.en: HBT60-13.132 on Diesel 60 does not import LZ-60’s pipe or aggregate. HBT80-1816-110 on Electric 80 does not import HBT80-16’s 100 / 125 mm pipe.
body.zh: 柴油60上的 HBT60-13.132 不会带入 LZ-60 的管径或骨料。电动80上的 HBT80-1816-110 不会带入 HBT80-16 的 100 / 125 mm 管径。

heading.en: No certificate fills a blank either

body.en: The sheets do not print a certificate name, an export-country list or a production-day count. Asking for those does not create the missing cell. Hebei Pinjin Machinery confirms price only by inquiry.
body.zh: 这些表不印证书名称、出口国名单或生产天数。索取这些内容不会生成缺失的格子。河北品锦机械只通过询盘确认价格。

question.en: May I write 380 V on Electric 20?
question.zh: 可以在电动20上写 380 V 吗？

answer.en: Not as a catalogue cell. That voltage is printed on B500S-83D. Send your site voltage as a site fact.
answer.zh: 不能写成目录格。该电压印在 B500S-83D 上。请把现场电压写成现场事实。

question.en: Is “consult factory” a blank I can replace with 300 m?
question.zh: “咨询工厂”是我可以改成 300 m 的空白吗？

answer.en: No. LZ-80 prints that phrase for delivery height. Leave the phrase as printed.
answer.zh: 不能。LZ-80 的输送高度印的就是这句话。保持原文。

question.en: Does Electric 10 have a hidden vertical rating?
question.zh: 电动10有隐藏的垂直参数吗？

answer.en: No vertical line is printed. The horizontal cell is 25 m.
answer.zh: 没有印垂直行。水平格是 25 m。

answer.en: Xingtai, if you ask on the contact page. The public sheet stays blank until the factory states otherwise.
answer.zh: 如果你在询盘页询问，由邢台回答。在工厂另有说明之前，公开参数表保持空白。
